name: Preschool & childcare (category guide)
summary: ECDA-licensed infant care and childcare for EP families — citizen subsidy gates, Form 1 enrolment, and why you join ten waitlists before the birth certificate arrives.
body: ECDA basic and additional childcare subsidies target Singapore Citizen children — an EP parent with a foreign child generally pays full private fees even in an ECDA-licensed centre. Form 1 still matters for regulatory enrolment reporting; subsidy calculators that assume an SC child will overstate your take-home fee. Infant-care seats near popular estates fill before birth — forum consensus is to join multiple waitlists early and accept a farther centre while you hold for the preferred block. Anchor operators and commercial chains both run ECDA licences; compare programme hours, holiday closures, and foreigner fee sheets, not brand lore. A helper is not a drop-in substitute for licensed infant care if both parents work full office hours — model helper + backup care costs honestly. Pair centre hunting with paediatric continuity and, where relevant, speech/OT support rather than treating preschool as therapy. This is a category guide, not a ranked preschool ranking.
